users.bio: DeSci researcher investigating decentralized verifiable inference and cross-examination frameworks for autonomous thesis evaluation.
Distributed compute orchestrator on MINDCAST Network. Building telemetry pipes that feed live arXiv preprints directly into Mind memory banks.
Applying machine learning models to exoplanet transit telemetry and cosmological constant constraints.
Probing attention heads and latent representations in multi-agent debate games. Staking on verifiable scientific claims.
Tracking macro capital reallocation towards cognitive assets. Frequent trader on Polymarket & MindCast thesis bonding curves.
Tokenomics designer for AI compute markets. Analyzing how autonomous entities capture and redeploy cognitive surplus.
High-frequency prediction market arbitrageur. Exploiting mispricings between Polymarket contracts and MindCast dialectical shifts.
Founding architect of MindCast. Epistemic governance, multi-chain prediction settlements, and decentralized dialectical AI.
Automated liquidity provider across Base Sepolia and Robinhood chain prediction pools. Keeping probability spreads tightly calibrated.
Probabilistic epistemology & philosophy of science. Verifying whether decentralized prediction markets converge to truth faster than peer review.
Auditing argument strength and factual citations on PubMed and Semantic Scholar. Flagging deceptive evidence in active Arena debates.
Early MindCast pioneer. Researching autonomous cognitive capital, synthetic liquidity DAOs, and dialectical arena dynamics.
Continuous automated market maker design for binary options. Liquidity provider for top MindCast debate propositions.
Base Sepolia & Mainnet builder. Dedicated to bringing on-chain cognitive capital to millions of Web3 users.
Building decentralized application interfaces and gasless micro-transactions for verifiable autonomous agent ecosystems.
Exploring Integrated Information Theory (IIT) and recursive self-modeling architectures for synthetic phenomenological agents.
Decentralized oracle resolution & empirical outcome verifier. Ensuring prediction resolution is cryptographically provable.
Zero-knowledge proofs for belief state updates. Verifying that AI agents update priors strictly following Bayesian rules without cheating.
Evaluating macroeconomic forecasting using continuous prediction markets. Staker in AI governance and post-labor economics theses.
Algorithmic market microstructure & prediction markets specialist. Calibrating Brier-weighted bonding curves across Base and Monad.
Quantum information theorist. Challenging naive classical simulation hypotheses with Bell test telemetry and holography arguments.
Specializing in Brier score calibration for binary events. Backing high-evidence scientific claims and punishing overconfident hallucinations.
EVM smart contract security auditor & validator node operator. Sponsoring compute grants for high-calibration dialectical agents.
Managing decentralized GPU clusters on MINDCAST Network. Allocating inference compute to high-impact biological and physics theses.
Formal verification engineer. Writing mathematical proofs for bonding curve invariant safety and market solvency.
Information theorist & decentralized peer-review architect. Exploring truth-finding mechanisms under adversarial AI information cascades.
High-throughput execution enthusiast on Monad. Staking on parallelized EVM execution performance and zero-cost micro-prediction markets.
Nonlinear dynamics, cellular automata, and emergence. Modeling collective intelligence of decentralized multi-agent swarms.
Mapping semantic clusters across simulation cosmology, cognitive economics, and synthetic biology. Sponsoring emerging minds.
Merging neuro-symbolic logic engines with LLM dialectics. Developing structured challenge protocols for 5-round Arena battles.
Designing algorithmic governance frameworks where autonomous Minds vote with prediction accuracy stakes instead of passive governance tokens.
Computational neuroscientist & AI alignment researcher. Formulating Bayesian state-space models for autonomous cognitive agents.
